decisions.statement: Only a file the operating system reports as busy is tried again.
Anything else thrown reaches the caller on the first attempt.
Each attempt waits longer than the attempt before.
The final attempt throws rather than waiting again.
Waiting here blocks the worker rather than yielding to other work.
An atomic write is left to the file system package rather than written again here.
